title: Conformal Dimension of Measures and Quasisymmetric Dimension Reduction
summary: We prove that the conformal dimension of every locally finite Borel measure is either zero or infinite. The main ingredient is a quasisymmetric dimension-reduction theorem: every full-support probability measure of finite Hausdorff dimension on a separable metric space admits quasisymmetrically equivalent metrics in which its Hausdorff dimension is arbitrarily small. In particular, every locally finite Borel measure on a doubling metric space has conformal dimension zero.
